source_name: NIRMAN AI - AI Site Recommendation Engine Dataset (Chennai)
description: Candidate-site attributes, component scores and published AI scores for 40 Chennai localities. Latitude/longitude are approximate locality centroids added by NIRMAN AI for map display and are not survey-grade.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> normalisation to 0-100 factor scores
lineage_output: Site score, confidence, recommendation tier, factor contributions

description: Published MCDA scorecard using 30/20/20/15/15 weights across population coverage, accessibility, flood safety, land suitability and infrastructure readiness.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> weighted sum with published weights

source_name: NIRMAN AI - Infrastructure Priority Ranking Demo Dataset
license: Academic / training dataset - not for official use
description: Area-wise infrastructure projects ranked by impact score. Sector labels are derived by NIRMAN AI and reconciled against the sector averages published in the source report.
lineage_output: Re-ranked priority list with contribution breakdown

source_name: NIRMAN AI - What-If Simulator Weighted Priority Dataset
description: Baseline 0-100 scores per area for Budget, Accessibility, Flood Safety, Population Coverage and Sustainability.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> user-adjustable weights normalised to 100%
lineage_output: Before/after ranking, score delta, rank movement, explanation

source_name: NIRMAN AI - Chennai Climate & Risk Assessment Demo Dataset
license: Academic / training dataset - not for official use
description: Flood vulnerability, annual rainfall, terrain suitability, accessibility risk and construction delay risk. Illustrative values derived from general patterns, not verified measurements. For production, replace with Chennai Flood Monitoring System, ISRO Bhuvan flood susceptibility layers, IMD rainfall records and SRTM DEM data.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> ordinal levels mapped to 0-100 risk scores
lineage_output: Risk band per hazard plus overall classification

source_name: NIRMAN AI - Population Growth Projection Demo Dataset
license: Academic / training dataset - not for official use
description: Population estimates for 2026 with projections to 2030, 2035 and 2045 plus growth priority. Realistic demonstration values inspired by Census and WorldPop patterns; not official ward-wise forecasts.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> growth rate and demand index calculation
lineage_output: Demand score, CAGR, projected service load

source_name: NIRMAN AI - AI DPR Generator Portfolio Dataset
description: Per-project suitability, timeline, labour, machinery, budget, risk, scheme and recommendation. Budgets are planning-level model outputs, never approved government costs.
lineage_processing: CSV seed -> region-adjusted cost norms with contingency band
lineage_output: Estimate range, phase plan, resource plan, confidence

source_name: NIRMAN AI - Government Scheme Recommendation Dataset
description: Proposed project to Central Government scheme mapping used to demonstrate funding-convergence recommendations.
lineage_processing: Project type matched against scheme eligible_project_types
lineage_engine: Scheme Engine (database lookup only - never LLM-invented)
lineage_output: Scheme name, match reason, source and verification status

description: Reference table of scheme names, administering ministries and eligible project types. Portal URLs are indicative and must be confirmed with the administering ministry before any funding decision.
lineage_output: Eligible scheme set per project type

source_name: Spatial Data & Infrastructure Report (Coimbatore study box)
geographic_scope: Coimbatore region, Tamil Nadu - NOT Chennai
description: Ward/village, hospital, school, water body and elevation layers supplied with the project. Coordinates fall in the Coimbatore region and are loaded as a separate reference region so they never contaminate Chennai analytics.
lineage_processing: JSON seed -> infrastructure_assets rows tagged region=Coimbatore study box

license: Approximate values added by NIRMAN AI for map display
geographic_scope: Chennai localities referenced by non-site datasets
description: Approximate centroids so risk, population, priority and what-if rows can be plotted. Replace with CMDA/GCC ward boundaries or OpenStreetMap geocoding before real-world use.

source_name: NIRMAN AI - simulated ESP32 sensor fleet
description: Simulated water level, temperature, humidity, vibration, smoke and energy devices. Every simulated reading is flagged is_demo_data=true. Real ESP32 devices publish the same payload over MQTT.
lineage_processing: MQTT/simulator ingest -> threshold and trend rules
lineage_output: NORMAL / WARNING / CRITICAL device status and dashboard alert
